description: V69 HangFix stock hook specification (Wave5 class-0x24 pool disposal across Photo->Movie->Playback for ProRes, N-RAW, H.265, H.264).
optional_compile_defines: -DLIVE_FILMSIM_POOL_HOOKS (when linked with FilmSim .o units: invokes filmsim_runtime_pool_suspend() in live_handoff_if_pool/live_w5_bringup_notify even when Live is OFF, and filmsim_runtime_pool_resume() in live_deferred_dispose upon Photo layout-0 return)

hooks.name: layout_switch_primary
hooks.layer: Layer 1 (pre-layout-switch, gated on cur_layout==0 && new_layout!=0 && BE_LV_0xa03b71788==0)

hooks.name: layout_switch_aux
hooks.layer: Layer 1 (pre-layout-switch, gated on cur_layout==0 && new_layout!=0 && BE_LV_0xa03b71788==0)

hooks.name: movs_playback_alloc
hooks.layer: Layer 2A (MOVS playback buffer allocator in View 2 Playback, before 0x40711da8 0x41046f84->0x41047014 & 0x40711db8 0x410463e4)

hooks.name: prores_hw_bringup
hooks.layer: Layer 2B (ProRes HW bring-up entry; catches both ProRes REC 0x40d1ea9c and ProRes PB 0x40cfa890)

hooks.name: pbprcmxm_subpool_enter
hooks.layer: Layer 1B (PBPRCMXM Command 46: 0x410463e4(layout=0, subflag=1) carves 646.81 MiB subpools 0x5a,0x5c..0x5f from Class 0x24; gated on cur_layout==0 && cur_subflag==0 && BE_LV_0xa03b71788==0)

hooks.name: pbprcmxm_layout_restore
hooks.layer: Layer 1B (PBPRCMXM Command 47: 0x410463e4(saved_layout) restores layout 0->non-0 when exiting Playback image management back to Movie; gated on cur_layout==0 && new_layout!=0 && BE_LV_0xa03b71788==0)

hooks.name: subpool_carve_direct
hooks.layer: Layer 1C (0x40f81680: BL 0x41046ef8 -> 0x41045e08 directly carves 647.55 MiB subpools 0x5a..0x5f from Class 0x24 bypassing 0x410463e4; gated on cur_layout==0 && cur_subflag==0 && BE_LV_0xa03b71788==0)

hooks.name: movs_layout_restore_tail
hooks.layer: Layer 1D (0x40712808: tail-call B 0x410463e4(0xa045f0ea8) restores saved layout after MOVS playback; gated on cur_layout==0 && BE_LV_0xa03b71788==0)

hooks.name: pb_arbiter_exit_guard
hooks.layer: Layer 3 (0x42ac31b8: PTR64 arbiter slot 0x2b KEY_PLAYBACK exit predicate 0x403917e8; swallows KEY_PLAYBACK while view=2/1 pb_state0 has no mounted page yet so post-shot Playback never bounces back to LV)
